name: grimoire-ai
description: Your codebase, decoded — AI-powered treemap visualization, inline annotation, import-based tags, and plain-English descriptions for any project

grim.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: API keys are now stored in VS Code's encrypted Secret Storage via the setup panel (`Grimoire: Setup / API Key`). Any value set here is automatically migrated to Secret Storage and then cleared. For headless setups, prefer the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable.
grim.anthropicApiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated:** storing the API key in settings keeps it in plaintext. Use `Grimoire: Setup / API Key` (encrypted Secret Storage) or the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable instead. Existing values are migrated automatically.

grim.model.description: Claude model to use for AI descriptions

grim.batchSize.description: Number of files per AI batch request

grim.maxConcurrency.markdownDescription: How many files to annotate in parallel during **Annotate Entire Workspace**. Higher is faster but more likely to hit Anthropic rate limits (Grimoire backs off and retries automatically). Range 1–12.

grim.exclude.description: Additional directories to exclude from scanning

grim.scanHeaders.description: Read first 40 lines of source files for better AI context and tag inference

grim.agentContext.markdownDescription: After each scan, write a compact `.grimoire-context.md` repo map for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to load for instant orientation. Run **Grimoire: Export Agent Context** to regenerate manually.

grim.incremental.markdownDescription: On re-scan, reuse AI descriptions for files whose header is unchanged and only send new/changed files to the model. Keeps the map fresh for a fraction of the cost. Disable to always re-describe everything.

grim.plainEnglish.markdownDescription: **Recommended for most users.** Write descriptions in plain English — no jargon like API, ORM, or middleware. Describes what each file *does* in everyday language, perfect for vibe coders and non-technical teammates.

enumDescriptions: Replace existing Grimoire comments when re-annotating (recommended)
Keep existing Grimoire comments and add new ones alongside
Ask every time — show a picker to choose Replace or Merge
grim.commentStrategy.markdownDescription: How to handle existing ᚲ Grimoire comments when re-annotating a file. **Replace** swaps old comments for new ones. **Merge** keeps both. **Ask** prompts you each time.

enumDescriptions: Teaching mode — explains WHY, names patterns, builds understanding
Just the essentials — one-line signpost comments
Best-practice annotations with proper terminology and patterns
Plain English — no jargon, real-world explanations
grim.defaultAnnotationMode.markdownDescription: Default annotation mode when running **Annotate Current File**. You can always change it from the picker.
